classification.rationale: Heading 8427 covers fork-lift trucks; unfinished ones with the essential character of the complete machine follow GRI 2(a). Internal combustion engine power places them in 8427.20. LPG forklifts are typically rider-type counterbalanced, so 8427.20.40 is assumed. No forklift ruling in the tool results matched (H312118 concerns engines only) so none is cited.
